prompts.world_v1:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished in-game concept image for our own existing isometric fantasy tower-defense/RPG, based on the supplied OWN-PROJECT native screenshot. Landscape 16:9, high resolution and crisp small UI. This is a proposed visual mockup, not proof of implemented gameplay.
Reference image role: exact existing game art, character, grass/ground, camera and Lunar Porcelain HUD reference. Preserve the current game's composition and hand-painted soft-volume look. Remove only the macOS title bar, purple capture badge and Development Build watermark; the canvas should be the game view.
PRIMARY CHANGE: show a recoverable lost inventory bag at the hero's death location, now being approached by the living hero. The dropped object is a small grounded brown leather satchel with a broad flap and a pale silver clasp, roughly knee-high to the hero, a convincing contact shadow, and a short restrained pale-lavender mist at its base. It is a personal lost bag, not treasure, a chest, a building, a gravestone, or a portal. No dead NPC, duplicate hero, blood, or new armor.
Above the physical satchel: a compact readable 32–36px-at-900p faceted silver/ivory medallion containing the SAME upright leather bag silhouette, plum shadows and a very thin lavender rim. Tiny tasteful fantasy craft, not a flat generic vector pin. Do not frame it in gold or use a rarity beam, gemstones, skulls, portal rings or exclamation marks.
Put the bag near the living hero on visible open ground, separated enough to read both silhouettes. The medallion must align with the pouch underneath it and remain smaller than the hero's head/upper body. Add one short existing-style nearby interaction label, text EXACTLY: "E · Забрать сумку". Optional compact name directly above it: "Потерянная сумка".
The same simplified bag motif appears once on the existing circular minimap near the hero marker, at about18–20px-at-900p. Keep hero and bag markers distinct.
PRESERVE HUD: one continuous wide bottom Lunar Porcelain dock; narrow icon/key navigation ribbon immediately above it; ten ability slots in two rows of five; left circular minimap and hero portrait; current HP/MP/XP colored numeric tracks on the right. Preserve the source HP/MP100/100, XP0/100 and labels HP, MP, XP. Do not redesign the HUD, shrink its safe zones, add menus or invent new stats/currencies.
IMPORTANT BEHAVIOR shown in this image: bag is in view, so NO screen-edge directional arrow is visible. No navigation route or glowing trail. No large explanatory text, no diagrams, no poster, no multiple panels, no logos, no comparison layout. A faithful full-game-view mockup with one new recoverable bag and its world/minimap marker.

prompts.map_v1:

Do NOT turn this into a parchment fantasy painting, redesign the map, add buildings, quest routes or new menus.
PRIMARY CHANGE: a single personal death-location marker on the map, away from the current hero marker. Use precisely the brown leather satchel silhouette with pale silver clasp, silver/ivory four-point/faceted medallion, plum shadows and thin soft lavender edge from Input2. A small crisp map icon, about28–32px at1600x900, not a huge oversized loot chest. Add a neat compact selected-marker label beside it, text EXACTLY "Место гибели". Use the same visual size/safe padding logic as existing map markers. Retain clear map land around the icon. No skull, gold rarity beam, gemstones, tombstone, quality rank, item level or exclamation pin.

Show existing zoom controls unobstructed. The world concept Input2's bottom hero HUD is NOT the map layout and should NOT be pasted into this fullscreen map; only borrow its new marker motif. No directions route, navigation trail, death screen, XP penalty text or revive button.
Single game-view mockup, no poster, no split panels, no explanatory insets, no OS chrome, no watermarks. This is a proposed visual design only, not implemented gameplay.
prompts.arrow_v1:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a second contextual state of this OWN-PROJECT fantasy game concept.
Input image is the world-marker proposal and exact world/HUD/art reference. Preserve camera, hero, grass, trees, same Lunar Porcelain bottom HUD, narrow navigation ribbon, circular minimap, ten spell slots and HP/MP/XP tracks100/100,100/100,0/100. No macOS chrome.
CHANGE ONLY THE DEATH MARKER STATE: the bag is now FAR OUTSIDE the world camera toward the upper-right. Remove the physical satchel on the ground, its ground mist, its hovering world medallion, and both nearby labels from the visible scene. Restore the original grass where they were. The living hero stays alone in the world.
Instead, show ONE screen-edge bearing pointer in the upper-right side of playable world view, below and clear of the clock/debug cards and far above the bottom HUD. Keep at least32px screen-edge inset at900p, never flush to border. The pointer is a compact32–36px silver/ivory faceted medallion with the SAME upright brown leather satchel and silver clasp motif; an attached short sculpted silver/lavender arrowhead points outward toward upper-right. The BAG illustration stays upright; only the small outside arrowhead indicates bearing. Restrained pale-lavender rim, no bright beam, gold, skull, exclamation mark, raw flat vector triangle or giant UI panel. Optional tiny plum/ivory caption directly beneath: EXACTLY "Место гибели", short and unobtrusive.
The world bag is OFFSCREEN, so no world bag/marker may remain visible. The minimap can retain the same bag icon if its position lies within minimap bounds; do not fabricate a route/trail or extra waypoint at hero. No distance number or invented units. This is a straight bearing indicator, not a promise of pathfinding.
Single faithful game-view concept, no side-by-side panels, no diagram, no additional controls or changes to game stats.
